# For the agent reading this

The agent briefing for this repository is [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Read it
before anything else: it covers what Soil Handover is, how to install it for
somebody, and how to work on this repository.

This file exists only because some hosts look here and not at the repository
root. It is deliberately a pointer rather than a copy. Two documents kept in
step by hand drift, and the one that drifts is the one nobody opened.
